title: Regulatory reliance for medicines access in low- and middle-income countries (2000-2026): derived data and reproducible code
description: Companion data and reproducible code for a bibliometric and thematic review of regulatory reliance for medicines access in low- and middle-income countries (2000-2026), submitted to the International Journal of Health Planning and Management. Contains the derived 2,071-record corpus (2,063 from a three-source systematic database search of PubMed, Europe PMC and WHO IRIS, plus 8 from a supplementary Chinese-language retrieval of CNKI, Wanfang and Weipu), the PRISMA 2020 transparency file, bibliometric and network analysis outputs, the nine manuscript figures, and the Python pipeline that generates them. Fifty records held in a curated institutional document collection are folded into the three-source count and their full texts are not redistributed; only extracted metadata are published. Raw API dumps and copyrighted journal PDFs used for style calibration are excluded.
